items.title: ECB confirms a 12-month digital-euro pilot
items.excerpt: Piero Cipollone said the pilot starts in the second half of 2027 with 36 payment providers. A new payment rail; the monetary framework stays the same.
items.excerpt_sk: Piero Cipollone povedal, že pilot začne v 2. polroku 2027 s 36 poskytovateľmi platieb. Nová platobná koľaj; menový rámec ostáva rovnaký.

items.title: Paraguay's Ueno Bank collapse locks out nearly three million customers
items.excerpt: The bank was ordered into resolution. Deposit-guarantee payouts have started; customers' bills did not wait.
items.title_sk: Pád paraguajskej Ueno Bank odrezal od peňazí takmer tri milióny klientov
items.excerpt_sk: Banka išla do riešenia krízy. Výplaty z garančného fondu sa začali; účty klientov nečakali.

items.title: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lose $1.28B in five sessions
items.excerpt: Net outflows of $1,281.7 million from 2 to 6 November. Four of five days were negative; Friday alone was −$411.9M, led by IBIT.
items.title_sk: Americké spotové bitcoinové ETF stratili za päť dní 1,28 mld. $
items.excerpt_sk: Čisté odlevy 1 281,7 mil. $ od 2. do 6. novembra. Štyri z piatich dní boli v mínuse; samotný piatok −411,9 mil. $, najviac IBIT.

items.title: France drops its €100,000 self-custody reporting rule
items.excerpt: The rule went out when the National Assembly rejected the revenue section of the 2027 budget.
items.title_sk: Francúzsko ruší povinné hlásenie vlastnej úschovy nad 100 000 €
items.excerpt_sk: Pravidlo padlo, keď Národné zhromaždenie zamietlo príjmovú časť rozpočtu na rok 2027.
